article.title: Anthropic試推EFS，零資料保留安排須配合客戶自有儲存
article.title_en: Anthropic launches EFS beta with customer-owned safety-data storage
article.summary: Anthropic宣布Enterprise Frontier Safeguards測試版，為合資格組織提供有指定範圍的零資料保留安排。
article.summary_en: Anthropic announced an Enterprise Frontier Safeguards beta offering scoped Zero Data Retention for eligible organizations.
highlights: 客戶須提供自有儲存桶，接收供應商格式加密的安全資料，並由內部團隊審閱安全個案。
安排不涵蓋Files上傳、程式執行容器、Batch結果及Managed Agents等功能資料。
highlights_en: Customers provide a bucket for sealed safety data and their own team reviews safety cases.
The arrangement excludes feature data such as Files uploads, code containers, Batch results and Managed Agents sessions.
article.why: 使用客戶資料的行銷助理，需分清一般API請求與檔案、執行環境的資料流，才能決定哪些工作適合接入這項安排。
article.why_en: Marketing-assistant teams need to distinguish API traffic from file and execution storage before deciding which client-data workflows fit the arrangement.
article.next_step: 把一項客戶報告流程拆成訊息、上傳檔案及程式執行三部分，請技術負責人逐項確認保留範圍及內部安全個案負責人。
article.next_step_en: Map a client-report workflow into messages, file uploads and code execution, then confirm retention coverage and an internal safety-case owner.
article.detail: EFS仍屬測試版，須按與Anthropic的協議取得資格。文件表示安全資料雖放在客戶雲端帳戶，仍採封存加密格式，客戶不能直接閱讀；這與安全個案由內部審閱是兩項不同安排。Anthropic不另收EFS費用，雲端儲存費照常計算。團隊應逐個功能核對適用範圍，不能把零資料保留名稱解作所有工具均不存資料。
article.detail_en: EFS remains a beta under an agreement with Anthropic. Sealed data in the customer's cloud bucket is not directly readable by that customer; internal safety-case review is a separate responsibility. Anthropic adds no EFS fee, while cloud-storage charges remain. The name does not mean every platform feature stores no data.
